explain.title: Decision Explanation (LayerCAM @ Layer 4)
explain.noImageOrDet: Run detection on an image in the Inspect tab and select a box first.
explain.apiRequiredNote: Note: True LayerCAM gradient computation requires PyTorch and runs via the local API server or Cloud Space.

explain.howDecidedSub: Summary generated strictly from model outputs and verified dataset statistics:
explain.energyInBoxLabel: Share of heatmap energy inside the box: {{pct}}%
explain.whatItShowsBody1: LayerCAM multiplies positive gradients back-propagated from the selected detection's class score with backbone Layer 4 activations, highlighting which image regions most supported the model's decision.
explain.whatItShowsMetrics: On the validation split (n={{n}}, imgsz={{imgsz}}), LayerCAM @ Layer 4 deletion fidelity achieved a mean relative score drop of {{drop1x}} at 1× box area (control {{ctrl1x}}, win rate {{win1x}}%) and {{drop2x}} at 2× area (control {{ctrl2x}}, win rate {{win2x}}%), with {{energy}}% of map energy inside the target box.
explain.whatItShowsCaveat: Although pointing game is {{pointing}}%, a randomly initialized network already reaches {{randPointing}}%; deletion testing is therefore used as the primary faithfulness evidence.

about.title: About Tracera
about.description: Tracera is an open-source inspection tool that detects 6 classes of PCB manufacturing defects (missing_hole, mouse_bite, open_circuit, short, spur, spurious_copper) using YOLO11s, evaluates cross-board generalization via board-grouped splits, and explains detections with LayerCAM (Layer 4).
about.limit1: PKU-Market-PCB contains only 10 distinct board designs; the locked test set spans 2 board designs (06 and 10).
about.limit2: Resolution CV was executed across 623 random-split images, so 1024 vs 640 selection is not fully independent of test boards (though the final model never trained on test boards).
about.limit3: On clean board 06 template images, the mouse_bite false positive recurs consistently; the reason spur scores rise on defected board 06 images remains unverified.
about.limit4: PCB-AoI has a small training set (142 images) with label noise; transfer yielded a null result.
about.limit5: Benchmark speeds were measured on laptop hardware.
